header.label: Extension for Open 2D Studio
header.title: Drawing Statistics
header.desc: Extension that displays shape counts and drawing statistics. Adds an Add-Ins ribbon tab with a Shape Count button and a terminal command.

features.title: Features

ribbon.title: Add-Ins ribbon tab
ribbon.desc: Adds a Shape Count button to the Add-Ins ribbon tab in Open 2D Studio.

terminal.title: Terminal command
terminal.desc: Registers a stats show terminal command to display statistics from the command line.

count.title: Entity counting
count.desc: Counts all entities by type in the current drawing.

features.requires: Requires Open 2D Studio v0.15.0 or later.
